description: Configure bubble interactions for a project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

artifactsLayer.description: Layer ID that renders the target features and uses selected/selectedProgress feature-state styling for current bubble results. May be the trigger layer when it already renders the targets.

linkFilter.description: GMS filter expression linking source to target features.

targetSource.description: Namespaced ID of the target source (source:uuid).

bubble.description: Bubble config or null to remove all bubbles.

title.description: Short description of the bubble change.

name: project_configure_bubbles
